newsitem.title: USA: Columbia/HCA now faces Florida probe - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Columbia/HCA now faces Florida probe - WSJ.

text.p: Columbia/HCA faces its third state investigation, a separate Medicaid fraud probe by Florida officials, the Wall Street Journal reported.

The state is trying to determine whether Columbia/HCA defrauded Florida taxpayers by exaggerating the amount of money it was to receive from the state for providing healthcare services to the poor, the paper said in its electronic edition.
Florida is the third state to disclose it is launching an independent probe of Columbia/HCA. Texas and Alabama have already launched their own investigations.
Last week, three midlevel Columbia/HCA officials were indicted amid a massive, ongoing federal probe of the company, the paper said.
